q: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, go to the sign-in page and click "Forgot password". We will email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: Team subscription is $8 per user per month. For 5 people, it would be 5 x $8 = $40 per month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: With the Free plan, you can store up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: For Plus subscriptions purchased within the last 14 days, you can request a refund. Please contact our support team with your order number so we can assist you further.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. You can contact support with your order number and they'll be happy to help.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: Yes, Example Notes has a web app that can be accessed from any modern web browser, which works on Linux.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Unfortunately, I don't know the answer to that. Example Notes is only listed as compatible with Android 12 or later. I recommend opening a support ticket to get more information.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: The web app does not work offline.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export, then select "PDF" as the export format. You can choose to export all notes, selected notes, or a specific folder. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Sorry to hear that you deleted a note by mistake. You can try to recover it from the Trash, where deleted notes are stored for 30 days. Go to Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: I don't know. Example Notes doesn't support SMS codes for two-factor authentication. You can use an authenticator app instead.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The free plan limits attachments to 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: I don't know. You can try opening a support ticket to find out the details of what happens to your Plus subscription if you cancel today.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: I can answer that for you. According to our FAQ, your data is stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: According to our FAQs, we reply to emails within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, Example Notes offers a 20% discount for annual billing. This is available for Plus and Team subscriptions.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: You can use three devices with a Plus subscription.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: Unfortunately, I don't know if Example Notes offers a student discount. Would you like to open a support ticket to ask about this?

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know and would be happy to help you open a support ticket to get more information about Example Notes' HIPAA compliance.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: No, we do not currently support importing notes from Evernote. If you're interested in using Example Notes, I can provide you with more information on our features and plans.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: I don't know and can't help with that. If you're interested in using Example Notes on Linux, I recommend opening a support ticket to request more information on a potential Linux desktop app.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I don't know how to write a Python script that sorts a list. If you'd like, I can help you open a support ticket to get assistance with this.

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I don't know and can't provide that information. I'm happy to help with any questions about Example Notes, though. Would you like to open a support ticket or ask about a specific feature?

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: I don't know how to undo a deleted note. Would you like to open a support ticket?

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: Only the Team plan ($8 per user per month) offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: Yes. On the Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB in size.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Contact us with your order number so we can assist you with a refund. We can provide a refund within 14 days of purchase.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: sign-in ページで "Forgot password" をクリックしてください。パスワードリセットのリンクは30分以内に送られます。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I'm so sorry to hear that you've experienced this issue multiple times. Unfortunately, I don't have the information to directly retrieve your lost notes. I recommend opening a support ticket with us at support@example.com, and we'll do our best to assist you in recovering your notes.
